BRAND IDENTITY / PORTFOLIO PROJECT

Christian Creator Lab

A restrained identity system that brings learning materials, merchandise and digital screens together.

DESIGNER / ODUSINA ISAACDISCIPLINE / BRAND IDENTITYVIEW THE PROJECT GALLERY ↓

Context

The collection presents a visual identity across digital screens, learning materials and merchandise.

Visual direction

A black symbol and wordmark are supported by neutral surfaces and a simple typographic system.

Design decisions

Consistent placement of the mark connects the bag, notebook, certificate and digital presentations. The neutral palette leaves room for content and photography.

Applications

Eight design presentations include a brand overview and boards showing the system across print, merchandise and screens.
